Plate is a square-ish plate, about 20-22 cm across (it spans ~355 px). The rice pile covers about 150 px × 400 px... roughly 140 px wide, so about 8 cm, with a height of ~2 cm. That is roughly 8×7×2 cm ≈ 110 cm³ at a half fill, which comes to about 60 g of cooked rice. There are also a few scattered grains, about 5 g, which brings the total to roughly 65 g. A faint yellowish oil or sauce residue is also visible, about 3 g.
